---
title: "Outreach"
---

Science communication has been a long-running part of my activity. I have spoken for general audiences about black holes, gravity, quantum theory, holography, spacetime singularities and the conceptual questions of fundamental physics.

## QuantumFracture

I have collaborated for many years as a **scientific advisor and contributor to QuantumFracture**, the Spanish-language science channel created by José Luis Crespo. My work with the channel has included scientific advice, script collaboration and appearances in videos.

A video co-authored with José Luis Crespo, **¿Puede estar caliente un agujero negro?**, won the **V Concurso de Divulgación CPAN** in 2014.

## Writing and media

- Cover story in **Investigación y Ciencia** (Spanish edition of *Scientific American*), *Ecos desde el horizonte*, with Pablo A. Cano (2019).
- Media interviews and coverage of work on regular black holes, wormholes, entanglement and quantum gravity.
- Public lectures and conversations in Spain and Latin America, aimed at audiences ranging from high-school students to general science audiences.

The recurring themes are black holes and singularities, gravity and quantum mechanics, holography, spacetime, entanglement and the open problems of fundamental physics.
